notes_for_editor: The Wisconsin AHI record (HI234016, surveyed 2017) is the only detailed source: 1934, metal, observation/fire tower, International Derrick and Equipment Company in the architect field, DNR staffing as needed until at least 2000, not demolished, not on a register. Standing status rests on the FFLA list (undated) and the AHI non-demolition note. Height, owner, access and fire history were not found after two searches. Next places to try: the AHI site file held by the SHPO, the Polk County Historical Society, and the DNR. The St. Croix 360 article is about the Gordon tower in Douglas County; it is cited only for the statewide 2015 DNR decommissioning and does not say whether Frederic was included. The 431 m figure is the OSM elevation tag at the tower's point, not tower height. Search snippets were not quoted.
